name: Back From The Brink
description: You are dead. Or that's what everyone thinks. Whatever horrible fate befell you didn't quite end your life, and any limbs you may have lost have been replaced by augmetics.
benefits: Roll on Memorable Injury table twice
Roll on Traumatic Injury table twice
Replace lost body parts with augmetics

name: Demanding Patron
description: Your exploits have caught the attention of someone powerful who will sponsor your future deeds, though they have demands in return.
benefits: Choose: 1 item of Rare Wargear (value 3 + new Tier)

name: Dauntless Reputation
description: With a single glorious act of extraordinary merit, you gained tremendous reputation. Word of your exploits has spread, and you have gained both notoriety and disciples.
benefits: Gain the Devotees Talent (no Leadership prerequisite)
A tremendous reputation with a Faction

name: Perfidious Wretch
description: You betrayed your allies to gain favour with another Faction. You may have been seduced by promises of power or material wealth.
benefits: 1 item of Wargear (value 3 + new Tier, Rare or lower)

name: Psychic Revelations
description: You are now a Psyker. Whether a spontaneous manifestation, development of latent abilities, or through unbidden exposure to Warp abnormalities.
benefits: Gain the Smite psychic power and Universal Psychic Powers
One Minor Psychic Power per Tier Ascended
May purchase psychic powers from one Discipline

name: Stay The Course
description: You are a veteran of your position, excelling far above your peers. Though not promoted, you have been recognised and rewarded.
benefits: Roll on Memorable Injury table (or gain 3 Corruption instead)
Choose: 2 items of Rare Wargear (value 3 + new Tier)
OR: 1 item of Very Rare Wargear (value 3 + new Tier)
